points.text: The answer says that the counter rounds the asked fathoms up to a whole number of 20-fathom hauls before the order is walked.
The answer says that the yarn the walk draws comes to the walked fathoms multiplied by the strand count of the lay.
The answer says that the whole yarn requirement is checked against the rack's total holding before any bundle is taken down.
The answer says that yarn bundles are drawn from the front of the rack in the order they were put up.
The answer says that the book prices the coil over the walked fathoms rather than the fathoms the customer asked for.

disqualifiers.text: The answer claims that the coil is walked, cut or charged at exactly the length the customer asked for.
The answer claims that an order the rack cannot fully cover is walked short from whatever yarn is there.
